subtitle: GTA V  ·  THE GAME WAS ON THE DISC

narration: This time you carry home a piece of plastic that tells your console to start a very long download, which makes the box a very expensive receipt.

title: A VERY EXPENSIVE RECEIPT

narration: Remember that, because it is the reason number one on this list hits everybody at the same time.
Number nine.
title: THE PRICE ARGUMENT

narration: Either way, a lot of the people shouting about it have already preloaded, so the argument is mostly noise by the time the game unlocks.

Number seven.
title: SCAMMERS
subtitle: Fake early access, fake betas

narration: Scammers.
Security firms including Malwarebytes have warned about fake sites selling so called VIP early access for a few hundred dollars in crypto.
title: SECURITY WARNING
subtitle: FAKE VIP EARLY ACCESS  ·  PAID IN CRYPTO

narration: Other pages push beta keys, and one fake download was literally named GTA Mobile 6.
title: cards
subtitle: THE FAKES::VIP EARLY ACCESS=A few hundred dollars in crypto|BETA KEYS=There is no beta|GTA MOBILE 6=A fake download

narration: The tells are always the same: a payment page that only takes crypto, a countdown timer that never ends, or an installer for a game that only exists on consoles.
title: scam

narration: Here is the simple version.
Rockstar has announced no beta, no early access, and no mobile version.
title: WHAT ROCKSTAR ANNOUNCED
subtitle: Beta=no; Early access=no; Mobile version=no

narration: If a link promises any of those, it is a trap, and because the payment is crypto, you pay and get nothing back.
title: IT IS A TRAP
subtitle: CRYPTO PAYMENTS DON'T COME BACK

narration: Your console clock will not save you.
Some players will try changing the time or the region to get in early.
One launch guide points out that on PlayStation, your account's country or region controls which store listing applies, and changing the console clock does not move the unlock time.

title: NO SINGLE MIDNIGHT

narration: There is no single midnight.
Store listings across 63 countries and regions show 15 separate unlock windows spread over nearly 19 hours, starting in New Zealand and finishing with Mexico and Central America.
title: unlock
subtitle: THERE IS NO SINGLE MIDNIGHT::15|19|New Zealand|Mexico & Central America

narration: Rockstar has not announced that schedule itself, so it is built from the store data.
title: FROM THE STORE DATA
subtitle: NOT ANNOUNCED BY ROCKSTAR

narration: But it means every time zone gets its own launch, and the internet is not waiting for you.
A player in Auckland could be describing the opening hours while you are still eating dinner.
By the time your midnight arrives, the reactions, the first complaints, and the first jokes have been piling up for most of a day.
And number one, the thing that actually decides your night. 212 gigabytes.
title: 212 GIGABYTES
subtitle: The download decides your night

Preload opened on November 10th, so if you started then, you are fine.
title: PRELOAD
subtitle: NOV 10=Preload opens; NOV 19 2026=Unlock

narration: If you did not, do the math.
On a 100 megabit connection, 212 gigabytes takes almost five hours.

narration: On 50, more than nine.
On 25, almost nineteen.
